pd_protocol: Keep Try.Src flag while debouncing. The PD_FLAGS_TRY_SRC flag was being cleared every time we entered the *_DISCONNECTED state. However, this would lead to a case where if the state machine was debouncing the CC lines and decided to re-enter the SRC_DISCONNECTED state, the Try.Src flag would be cleared and the state machine would not transition to the TryWait.SNK state after timing out. This commit simply keeps the Try.Src flag set if the previous state was a debounce as it means the state machine decided it didn't meet the condition to exit and should continue waiting before transitioning to TryWait.SNK. CHROMIUM: devfreq: clk-rk3288-dmc: Be less spammy DDR frequency changes sometimes are aborted if they can't be completed during a display VBLANK. In case of a timeout the DMC driver performs a few retries. Currently an error message is logged on timeout failures, which is a bit spammy since these timeouts are known to occur and a retry mechanism is in place. Change the log level of these messages from ERROR to DEBUG. If all retries fail the DMC driver still logs an error message.
